title: Implement SimNode state tracking
description: Create python/src/lichen/sim/node.py. SimNode dataclass: id (str), position (tuple[float,float,float]), tx_power_dbm (default 22), state enum (IDLE, TX, RX_WAIT), pending_rx_future (for async wakeup), connected (bool), last_seen_time_us. Methods: set_position(x,y,z), disconnect(), is_online(). Position is mutable for mobility support.
notes: Verified complete 2026-08-27. Existing SimNode satisfies required id/position/default 22 dBm/state/pending future/connected/last_seen fields; mutable positioning; IDLE/TX/RX_WAIT transitions through the shared state machine; disconnect cancellation/cleanup and idempotence; online status; independent default NodeMetrics; and TDMA/hop state integration. Focused Simulation node-management tests cover duplicate-ID failure, add/get/remove lifecycle, disconnect, pending-event purge, missing-node safety, connected-node counters, and enumeration. Production files were already complete and unchanged. Corrected one stale focused-test mypy suppression by narrowing the queued event with isinstance(RxTimeoutEvent). Verification from python/: uv run pytest tests/sim/test_node.py tests/sim/test_nodes.py -q => 41 passed; focused Ruff => All checks passed; focused mypy => Success, no issues; git diff --check passed.
close_reason: SimNode state tracking and simulation lifecycle integration verified complete; 41 focused tests, Ruff, and mypy pass.
